title: Regional Input-to-State Stability for Systems on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we study regional input-to-state stability (regional ISS) for time-varying control systems evolving on connected and complete Riemannian manifolds with a prescribed open state domain. Using the Riemannian distance, we formulate the notion of a region of ISS and introduce an ISS-Lyapunov function. We prove that the existence of such a function implies regional ISS in an explicitly estimated geodesic ball and yields a corresponding admissible input bound.
